youtube_title: Aunt Pat has been first in line every year for twenty years. This year we found out why 🛒
description:
It is five in the morning and Aunt Pat has a plan, a whistle and a map drawn on a napkin. Her nephew Eli has a coffee and a lot of questions. The line behind them is very, very quiet.

#cartoon #animation #funny #blackfriday #shorts
tiktok_caption: five a.m. the doors open in one minute. go. go. go. 🛒 #cartoon #animation #funny #blackfriday

lines.text: Eli. Listen to me. When those doors open, we go. Go. Go.
Aunt Pat, it is five in the morning. I am still asleep. This is a dream.
I am his coffee. I am doing everything I can.
Twenty years. First in line. Every single year.
Do you ever buy anything?
Not the point. Look at the map.
This is a napkin. From the pie place.
It is a map on a napkin. Big difference.
Door. Left. Past the candles. Hard right at the socks.
She drew the socks as a little cloud. I find that beautiful.
What are we even getting?
A waffle maker shaped like a snowman. Nine dollars.
You have four of those.
Five. One is a backup snowman.
Good morning, Pat.
Hollis.
Doors open in thirty seconds. Please walk.
Nobody walks, Hollis. Walking is for people with no dreams.
Twenty seconds. I can feel my foam getting nervous.
Ten. Nine. Eli, stretch your legs.
I am stretching my legs. They are filing a complaint.
And the doors are open.
Go. Go. Go.
He went left. She said right. He is in the bathroom.
The map had a little cloud. I thought it meant bathroom.
The cloud is socks, Eli. Everybody knows the cloud is socks.
Doesn't matter. Snowman aisle. Go. Go. Go.
I am spilling. I am a latte with a lot of experiences now.
Aunt Pat. Stop. Turn around.
We never turn around. Turning around is how you lose a snowman.
Nobody is running behind us. Nobody came in.
The line is still outside. It has not moved. It is very polite.
Aunt Pat. Why is the whole line made of lawn snowmen?
I don't know what you are talking about.
She brings them every year. Forty of them. On a wagon.
She plugs them into my coffee machine.
So that is why I taste like a snowman.
Fine. Nobody else has waited in this line since two thousand fourteen.
Everybody shops on their phone now. In their pajamas. Like animals.
But a line by yourself is just standing. So I bring friends.
That is the saddest and coolest thing I have ever heard.
And every year she lets me win the race to the snowman aisle.
Wait. You run too?
Twenty years. I have never once walked.
He has the fastest knees in the county.
So, one waffle snowman. Can we please go home?
About that. We are sold out. Somebody bought them all online.
Who would do that?
Me. Last night. In my pajamas. They are for you.
Six snowmen. Eli, I have never been so proud or so mad.
Then this was all for nothing.
Nothing? Hollis, same time next year?
Bring the snowmen.
Now everybody home and back in bed. Go. Go. Go.
Finally. A go I can get behind.
